description: Unit test script for shopping cart functionality in ERPNext, testing quotation creation, cart updates, tax rules, and user setup.

classes.name: TestShoppingCart
classes.description: Unit test class for shopping cart features including cart operations, user setup, and tax rules.

methods.name: tearDownClass
methods.description: Cleans up tax rules after tests.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, sets user, creates contact, enables shopping cart.

methods.name: test_get_cart_new_user
methods.description: Tests cart retrieval for a new user.

methods.name: test_get_cart_customer
methods.description: Tests cart retrieval for an existing customer.

methods.name: test_add_to_cart
methods.description: Tests adding items to cart and verifying contents.

methods.name: test_update_cart
methods.description: Tests updating item quantities in cart.

methods.name: test_tax_rule
methods.description: Tests creation and application of tax rules to quotations.

methods.name: create_tax_rule
methods.description: Creates a test tax rule record.

methods.name: create_quotation
methods.description: Creates a test quotation with predefined data.

methods.name: enable_shopping_cart
methods.description: Enables shopping cart settings and inserts item prices.

methods.name: login_as_new_user
methods.description: Logs in as a new test user.

methods.name: login_as_customer
methods.description: Logs in as a test customer.

methods.name: clear_existing_quotations
methods.description: Removes existing shopping cart quotations for the user.

methods.name: create_user_if_not_exists
methods.description: Creates a user if it does not already exist.
